audit_status.source_base: Hebrew/Aramaic source via Sefaria with source/English versification reconciliation; public-domain KJV familiar comparison
audit_status.review_note: Draft restoration of Ezra 7 follows the Hebrew/Aramaic witness: genealogical formulae preserved, Aramaic royal-decree material rendered as administrative speech, YHWH restored where the Hebrew has יהוה. Dates, measures, and Aramaic legal terms flagged for witness-check. Kept ambiguities and legal violence intact for further review.

verses.restored: After these matters, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, son of Azariah, son of Hilkiah,

familiar.text: Now after these things, in the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra the son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

modern.text: Many years later, during the reign of Artaxerxes king of Persia, Ezra son of Seraiah, the son of Azariah, the son of Hilkiah,

original.text: וְאַחַר֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּמַלְכ֖וּת אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֣סְתְּא מֶֽלֶךְ פָּרָ֑ס עֶזְרָא֙ בֶּן שְׂרָיָ֔ה בֶּן עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן חִלְקִיָּֽה

verses.restored: son of Shallum, son of Zadok, son of Ahitub,

familiar.text: The son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

modern.text: the son of Shallum, the son of Zadok, the son of Ahitub,

original.text: בֶּן שַׁלּ֥וּם בֶּן צָד֖וֹק בֶּן אֲחִיטֽוּב

verses.restored: son of Amariah, son of Azariah, son of Meraioth,

familiar.text: The son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

modern.text: the son of Amariah, the son of Azariah, the son of Meraioth,

original.text: בֶּן אֲמַרְיָ֥ה בֶן עֲזַרְיָ֖ה בֶּן מְרָיֽוֹת

verses.restored: son of Zerahiah, son of Uzzi, son of Bukki,

familiar.text: The son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

modern.text: the son of Zerahiah, the son of Uzzi, the son of Bukki,

original.text: בֶּן זְרַֽחְיָ֥ה בֶן עֻזִּ֖י בֶּן בֻּקִּֽי

verses.restored: son of Abishua, son of Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the chief priest.

familiar.text: The son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest:

modern.text: the son of Abishua, the son of Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the chief priest—

original.text: בֶּן אֲבִישׁ֗וּעַ בֶּן פִּֽינְחָס֙ בֶּן אֶלְעָזָ֔ר בֶּן אַהֲרֹ֥ן הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הָרֹֽאשׁ

verses.restored: This Ezra went up from Babylon; he was a skilled scribe in the law of Moses that YHWH, God of Israel, had given, and the king granted him all his requests, for the hand of YHWH his God was upon him.

familiar.text: This Ezra went up from Babylon; and he was a ready scribe in the law of Moses, which the LORD God of Israel had given: and the king granted him all his request, according to the hand of the LORD his God upon him.

notes.title: short
notes.body: The phrase 'hand of YHWH' indicates divine favour as the rationale for royal support.

modern.text: this Ezra came up from Babylon. He was a scribe skilled in the Law of Moses, which the LORD, the God of Israel, had given. The king had granted Ezra all his requests, for the hand of the LORD his God was upon him.

original.text: ה֤וּא עֶזְרָא֙ עָלָ֣ה מִבָּבֶ֔ל וְהֽוּא סֹפֵ֤ר מָהִיר֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֲשֶׁר נָתַ֥ן יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּתֶּן ל֣וֹ הַמֶּ֗לֶךְ כְּיַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהָיו֙ עָלָ֔יו כֹּ֖ל בַּקָּשָׁתֽוֹ

verses.restored: And some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and of the Levites, and of the singers, and of the porters, and of the Nethinim went up to Jerusalem in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

familiar.text: And there went up some of the children of Israel, and of the priests, and the Levites, and the singers, and the porters, and the Nethinims, unto Jerusalem, in the seventh year of Artaxerxes the king.

modern.text: So in the seventh year of King Artaxerxes, he went up to Jerusalem with some of the Israelites, including priests, Levites, singers, gatekeepers, and temple servants.

original.text: וַיַּֽעֲל֣וּ מִבְּנֵֽי יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל וּמִן הַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים וְהַלְוִיִּ֜ם וְהַמְשֹׁרְרִ֧ים וְהַשֹּׁעֲרִ֛ים וְהַנְּתִינִ֖ים אֶל יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם בִּשְׁנַת שֶׁ֖בַע לְאַרְתַּחְשַׁ֥סְתְּא הַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: He arrived at Jerusalem in the fifth month; that was in the king's seventh year.

familiar.text: And he came to Jerusalem in the fifth month, which was in the seventh year of the king.

modern.text: Ezra arrived in Jerusalem in the fifth month of the seventh year of the king.

original.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֑י הִ֛יא שְׁנַ֥ת הַשְּׁבִיעִ֖ית לַמֶּֽלֶךְ

verses.restored: For on the first day of the first month he set out from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month he came to Jerusalem, by the good hand of his God upon him.

familiar.text: For upon the first day of the first month began he to go up from Babylon, and on the first day of the fifth month came he to Jerusalem, according to the good hand of his God upon him.

modern.text: He had begun the journey from Babylon on the first day of the first month, and he arrived in Jerusalem on the first day of the fifth month, for the gracious hand of his God was upon him.

original.text: כִּ֗י בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן ה֣וּא יְסֻ֔ד הַֽמַּעֲלָ֖ה מִבָּבֶ֑ל וּבְאֶחָ֞ד לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַחֲמִישִׁ֗י בָּ֚א אֶל יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם כְּיַד אֱלֹהָ֖יו הַטּוֹבָ֥ה עָלָֽיו

verses.restored: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of YHWH, to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

familiar.text: For Ezra had prepared his heart to seek the law of the LORD, and to do it, and to teach in Israel statutes and judgments.

modern.text: For Ezra had set his heart to study the Law of the LORD, to practice it, and to teach its statutes and ordinances in Israel. Artaxerxes’ Letter for Ezra

original.text: כִּ֤י עֶזְרָא֙ הֵכִ֣ין לְבָב֔וֹ לִדְר֛וֹשׁ אֶת תּוֹרַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה וְלַעֲשֹׂ֑ת וּלְלַמֵּ֥ד בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּֽט

verses.restored: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave to Ezra the priest, the scribe—a copy of the words of the commandments of YHWH and his statutes for Israel.

familiar.text: Now this is the copy of the letter that the king Artaxerxes gave unto Ezra the priest, the scribe, even a scribe of the words of the commandments of the LORD, and of his statutes to Israel.

modern.text: This is the text of the letter King Artaxerxes had given to Ezra the priest and scribe, an expert in the commandments and statutes of the LORD to Israel:

original.text: וְזֶ֣ה פַּרְשֶׁ֣גֶן הַֽנִּשְׁתְּוָ֗ן אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָתַן֙ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא לְעֶזְרָ֥א הַכֹּהֵ֖ן הַסֹּפֵ֑ר סֹפֵ֞ר דִּבְרֵ֧י מִצְוֺת יְהוָ֛ה וְחֻקָּ֖יו עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: Artaxerxes, king of kings, to Ezra the priest, scribe of the law of the God of heaven: perfect peace.

familiar.text: Artaxerxes, king of kings, unto Ezra the priest, a scribe of the law of the God of heaven, perfect peace, and at such a time.

modern.text: Artaxerxes, king of kings. To Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven: Greetings.

original.text: אַ֨רְתַּחְשַׁ֔סְתְּא מֶ֖לֶךְ מַלְכַיָּ֑א לְעֶזְרָ֣א כָ֠הֲנָא סָפַ֨ר דָּתָ֜א דִּֽי אֱלָ֧הּ שְׁמַיָּ֛א גְּמִ֖יר וּכְעֶֽנֶת

verses.restored: I make a decree: all the people of Israel, and their priests and Levites within my realm who voluntarily set their heart to go to Jerusalem, shall go with you.

familiar.text: I make a decree, that all they of the people of Israel, and of his priests and Levites, in my realm, which are minded of their own freewill to go up to Jerusalem, go with thee.

modern.text: I hereby decree that any volunteers among the Israelites in my kingdom, including the priests and Levites, may go up with you to Jerusalem.

original.text: מִנִּי֮ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵם֒ דִּ֣י כָל מִתְנַדַּ֣ב בְּמַלְכוּתִי֩ מִן עַמָּ֨ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וְכָהֲנ֣וֹהִי וְלֵוָיֵ֗א לִמְהָ֧ךְ לִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֛ם עִמָּ֖ךְ יְהָֽךְ

verses.restored: For you have been sent by the king and his seven counselors to make inquiries concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of your God that is in your hand,

familiar.text: Forasmuch as thou art sent of the king, and of his seven counsellors, to enquire concerning Judah and Jerusalem, according to the law of thy God which is in thine hand;

modern.text: You are sent by the king and his seven counselors to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand.

original.text: כָּל קֳבֵ֗ל דִּי֩ מִן קֳדָ֨ם מַלְכָּ֜א וְשִׁבְעַ֤ת יָעֲטֹ֨הִי֙ שְׁלִ֔יחַ לְבַקָּרָ֥א עַל יְה֖וּד וְלִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֑ם בְּדָ֥ת אֱלָהָ֖ךְ דִּ֥י בִידָֽךְ

verses.restored: and to carry silver and gold, freely offered by the king and his counselors to the God of Israel whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

familiar.text: And to carry the silver and gold, which the king and his counsellors have freely offered unto the God of Israel, whose habitation is in Jerusalem,

modern.text: Moreover, you are to take with you the silver and gold that the king and his counselors have freely offered to the God of Israel, whose dwelling is in Jerusalem,

original.text: וּלְהֵיבָלָ֖ה כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֑ב דִּֽי מַלְכָּ֣א וְיָעֲט֗וֹהִי הִתְנַדַּ֨בוּ֙ לֶאֱלָ֣הּ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל דִּ֥י בִֽירוּשְׁלֶ֖ם מִשְׁכְּנֵֽהּ

verses.restored: and all the silver and gold that you can find in the province of Babylon, with voluntary offerings of the people and of the priests, who willingly offer for the house of their God in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: And all the silver and gold that thou canst find in all the province of Babylon, with the freewill offering of the people, and of the priests, offering willingly for the house of their God which is in Jerusalem:

modern.text: together with all the silver and gold you may find in all the province of Babylon, as well as the freewill offerings of the people and priests to the house of their God in Jerusalem.

original.text: וְכֹל֙ כְּסַ֣ף וּדְהַ֔ב דִּ֣י תְהַשְׁכַּ֔ח בְּכֹ֖ל מְדִינַ֣ת בָּבֶ֑ל עִם֩ הִתְנַדָּב֨וּת עַמָּ֤א וְכָֽהֲנַיָּא֙ מִֽתְנַדְּבִ֔ין לְבֵ֥ית אֱלָהֲהֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם

verses.restored: Buy promptly with this money bulls, rams, lambs, with their meal-offerings and their drink-offerings, and offer them on the altar of the house of your God in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: That thou mayest buy speedily with this money bullocks, rams, lambs, with their meat offerings and their drink offerings, and offer them upon the altar of the house of your God which is in Jerusalem.

modern.text: With this money, therefore, you are to buy as many bulls, rams, and lambs as needed, together with their grain offerings and drink offerings, and offer them on the altar at the house of your God in Jerusalem.

original.text: כָּל קֳבֵ֣ל דְּנָה֩ אָסְפַּ֨רְנָא תִקְנֵ֜א בְּכַסְפָּ֣א דְנָ֗ה תּוֹרִ֤ין דִּכְרִין֙ אִמְּרִ֔ין וּמִנְחָתְה֖וֹן וְנִסְכֵּיה֑וֹן וּתְקָרֵ֣ב הִמּ֔וֹ עַֽל מַדְבְּחָ֔ה דִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם דִּ֥י בִירוּשְׁלֶֽם

verses.restored: And do whatever seems good to you and to your brothers to do with the remainder of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.

familiar.text: And whatsoever shall seem good to thee, and to thy brethren, to do with the rest of the silver and the gold, that do after the will of your God.

modern.text: You and your brothers may do whatever seems best with the rest of the silver and gold, according to the will of your God.

original.text: וּמָ֣ה דִי֩ עליך וְעַל אחיך יֵיטַ֗ב בִּשְׁאָ֛ר כַּסְפָּ֥א וְדַהֲבָ֖ה לְמֶעְבַּ֑ד כִּרְע֥וּת אֱלָהֲכֹ֖ם תַּעַבְדֽוּן

verses.restored: The vessels of the house of your God that the men of Israel and the priests have presented you, you shall deliver before God in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: The vessels also that are given thee for the service of the house of thy God, those deliver thou before the God of Jerusalem.

modern.text: You must deliver to the God of Jerusalem all the articles given to you for the service of the house of your God.

original.text: וּמָֽאנַיָּא֙ דִּֽי מִתְיַהֲבִ֣ין לָ֔ךְ לְפָלְחָ֖ן בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֑ךְ הַשְׁלֵ֕ם קֳדָ֖ם אֱלָ֥הּ יְרוּשְׁלֶֽם

verses.restored: And whatever else is needed for the house of your God which you must provide, you shall take from the king's treasury.

familiar.text: And whatsoever more shall be needful for the house of thy God, which thou shalt have occasion to bestow, bestow it out of the king’s treasure house.

modern.text: And if anything else is needed for the house of your God that you may have occasion to supply, you may pay for it from the royal treasury.

original.text: וּשְׁאָ֗ר חַשְׁחוּת֙ בֵּ֣ית אֱלָהָ֔ךְ דִּ֥י יִפֶּל לָ֖ךְ לְמִנְתַּ֑ן תִּנְתֵּ֕ן מִן בֵּ֖ית גִּנְזֵ֥י מַלְכָּֽא

verses.restored: And I, Artaxerxes the king, make a decree to all the treasurers beyond the river: whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, let it be done speedily,

familiar.text: And I, even I Artaxerxes the king, do make a decree to all the treasurers which are beyond the river, that whatsoever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the law of the God of heaven, shall require of you, it be done speedily,

modern.text: I, King Artaxerxes, decree to all the treasurers west of the Euphrates: Whatever Ezra the priest, the scribe of the Law of the God of heaven, may require of you, it must be provided promptly,

original.text: וּ֠מִנִּי אֲנָ֞ה אַרְתַּחְשַׁ֤סְתְּא מַלְכָּא֙ שִׂ֣ים טְעֵ֔ם לְכֹל֙ גִּזַּֽבְרַיָּ֔א דִּ֖י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֑ה דִּ֣י כָל דִּ֣י יִ֠שְׁאֲלֶנְכוֹן עֶזְרָ֨א כָהֲנָ֜ה סָפַ֤ר דָּתָא֙ דִּֽי אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א אָסְפַּ֖רְנָא יִתְעֲבִֽד

verses.restored: up to a hundred talents of silver, up to a hundred measures of wheat, up to a hundred baths of wine, up to a hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribed weight.

familiar.text: Unto an hundred talents of silver, and to an hundred measures of wheat, and to an hundred baths of wine, and to an hundred baths of oil, and salt without prescribing how much.

notes.title: short
notes.body: Units (talents, measures, baths) follow Aramaic list; quantities need witness-check for precise equivalence.

modern.text: up to a hundred talents of silver, a hundred cors of wheat, a hundred baths of wine, a hundred baths of olive oil, and salt without limit.

original.text: עַד כְּסַף֮ כַּכְּרִ֣ין מְאָה֒ וְעַד חִנְטִין֙ כֹּרִ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד חֲמַר֙ בַּתִּ֣ין מְאָ֔ה וְעַד בַּתִּ֥ין מְשַׁ֖ח מְאָ֑ה וּמְלַ֖ח דִּי לָ֥א כְתָֽב

verses.restored: Whatever the God of heaven may command, be careful to do it for the house of the God of heaven, for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

familiar.text: Whatsoever is commanded by the God of heaven, let it be diligently done for the house of the God of heaven: for why should there be wrath against the realm of the king and his sons?

modern.text: Whatever is commanded by the God of heaven must be done diligently for His house. For why should wrath fall on the realm of the king and his sons?

original.text: כָּל דִּ֗י מִן טַ֨עַם֙ אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֔א יִתְעֲבֵד֙ אַדְרַזְדָּ֔א לְבֵ֖ית אֱלָ֣הּ שְׁמַיָּ֑א דִּֽי לְמָ֤ה לֶֽהֱוֵא֙ קְצַ֔ף עַל מַלְכ֥וּת מַלְכָּ֖א וּבְנֽוֹהִי

verses.restored: Also we inform you that you must not impose toll, tribute, or custom on any of the priests, Levites, singers, porters, Nethinim, or ministers of this house of God.

familiar.text: Also we certify you, that touching any of the priests and Levites, singers, porters, Nethinims, or ministers of this house of God, it shall not be lawful to impose toll, tribute, or custom, upon them.

modern.text: And be advised that you have no authority to impose tribute, duty, or toll on any of the priests, Levites, singers, doorkeepers, temple servants, or other servants of this house of God.

original.text: וּלְכֹ֣ם מְהוֹדְעִ֗ין דִּ֣י כָל כָּהֲנַיָּ֣א וְ֠לֵוָיֵא זַמָּ֨רַיָּ֤א תָרָֽעַיָּא֙ נְתִ֣ינַיָּ֔א וּפָ֣לְחֵ֔י בֵּ֖ית אֱלָהָ֣א דְנָ֑ה מִנְדָּ֤ה בְלוֹ֙ וַהֲלָ֔ךְ לָ֥א שַׁלִּ֖יט לְמִרְמֵ֥א עֲלֵיהֹֽם

verses.restored: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God that is in your hand, appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people beyond the river who know the laws of your God, and teach those who do not know them.

familiar.text: And thou, Ezra, after the wisdom of thy God, that is in thine hand, set magistrates and judges, which may judge all the people that are beyond the river, all such as know the laws of thy God; and teach ye them that know them not.

modern.text: And you, Ezra, according to the wisdom of your God which you possess, are to appoint magistrates and judges to judge all the people west of the Euphrates—all who know the laws of your God. And you are to teach these laws to anyone who does not know them.

original.text: וְאַ֣נְתְּ עֶזְרָ֗א כְּחָכְמַ֨ת אֱלָהָ֤ךְ דִּֽי בִידָךְ֙ מֶ֣נִּי שָׁפְטִ֞ין וְדַיָּנִ֗ין דִּי לֶהֱוֺ֤ן דאנין לְכָל עַמָּה֙ דִּ֚י בַּעֲבַ֣ר נַהֲרָ֔ה לְכָל יָדְעֵ֖י דָּתֵ֣י אֱלָהָ֑ךְ וְדִ֧י לָ֦א יָדַ֖ע תְּהוֹדְעֽוּן

verses.restored: And whoever will not do the law of your God nor the law of the king, let judgment be speedily executed upon him—whether by death, exile, confiscation of goods, or imprisonment.

familiar.text: And whosoever will not do the law of thy God, and the law of the king, let judgment be executed speedily upon him, whether it be unto death, or to banishment, or to confiscation of goods, or to imprisonment.

modern.text: If anyone does not keep the law of your God and the law of the king, let a strict judgment be executed against him, whether death, banishment, confiscation of property, or imprisonment. Ezra Blesses God

original.text: וְכָל דִּי לָא֩ לֶהֱוֵ֨א עָבֵ֜ד דָּתָ֣א דִֽי אֱלָהָ֗ךְ וְדָתָא֙ דִּ֣י מַלְכָּ֔א אָסְפַּ֕רְנָא דִּינָ֕ה לֶהֱוֵ֥א מִתְעֲבֵ֖ד מִנֵּ֑הּ הֵ֤ן לְמוֹת֙ הֵ֣ן לשרשו הֵן לַעֲנָ֥שׁ נִכְסִ֖ין וְלֶאֱסוּרִֽין

verses.restored: Blessed be YHWH, the God of our fathers, who put such a thing as this in the king's heart to beautify the house of YHWH that is in Jerusalem.

familiar.text: Blessed be the LORD God of our fathers, which hath put such a thing as this in the king’s heart, to beautify the house of the LORD which is in Jerusalem:

modern.text: Blessed be the LORD, the God of our fathers, who has put into the heart of the king to so honor the house of the LORD in Jerusalem,

original.text: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֲבוֹתֵ֑ינוּ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן כָּזֹאת֙ בְּלֵ֣ב הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ לְפָאֵ֕ר אֶת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם

verses.restored: And has shown me mercy before the king and his counselors and all the king's mighty officers. So I gathered chief men from Israel to go up with me.

familiar.text: And hath extended mercy unto me before the king, and his counsellors, and before all the king’s mighty princes. And I was strengthened as the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, and I gathered together out of Israel chief men to go up with me.

modern.text: and who has shown me favor before the king, his counselors, and all his powerful officials. And because the hand of the LORD my God was upon me, I took courage and gathered the leaders of Israel to return with me.

original.text: וְעָלַ֣י הִטָּה חֶ֗סֶד לִפְנֵ֤י הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ וְיֽוֹעֲצָ֔יו וּלְכָל שָׂרֵ֥י הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ הַגִּבֹּרִ֑ים וַאֲנִ֣י הִתְחַזַּ֗קְתִּי כְּיַד יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהַי֙ עָלַ֔י וָאֶקְבְּצָ֧ה מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֛ל רָאשִׁ֖ים לַעֲל֥וֹת עִמִּֽי

translation_notes: Chapter mixes Hebrew genealogy and Aramaic official correspondence; Aramaic administrative words (e.g., פרשגן, מַלְכַּיָּא) are retained where source dictates.
Divine name: יהוה rendered as YHWH. Where source uses 'God of heaven' (אֱלָהּ שְׁמַיָּא) preserved as 'God of heaven'.
Monetary and capacity units (talents, measures, baths, baths of oil) follow the Aramaic list but are flagged for numeric witness-check.
safety_note: Contains ancient legal and imperial violence; preserve context and avoid using as justification for modern harm.
